diff --git a/changelog.d/1328.change.md b/changelog.d/1328.change.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..4903414
--- /dev/null
+++ b/changelog.d/1328.change.md
@@ -0,0 +1,4 @@
+`attrs.Converter` is now a kind of adapter: instances are always callable with the value, the instance, and the field, and pass on only the arguments that the wrapped converter has asked for.
+
+Thanks to that, `attrs.converters.pipe()` now passes the instance and the field to wrapped `attrs.Converter`s instead of the values of their *takes_self* and *takes_field* arguments.
+It also only returns an `attrs.Converter` if at least one of the piped converters is one -- otherwise it returns a plain callable as before.
